zh.caption: 圖 1｜一個完整的最小流程
zh.description: 客人點餐後檢查食材；有食材與沒有食材為條件分支，並非先後步驟。

zh.caption: 圖 2｜最小但完整的文件處理流程
zh.description: 依序輸入、檢查、修正重查、預覽與匯出；缺漏時不能完整匯出，修改後舊結果失效。

items.title: 2. 檢查資料
items.body: 系統判斷必要欄位是否缺漏

items.title: 3. 提示並修正
items.body: 缺漏時不能完整匯出，補齊後重新檢查

items.title: 4. 預覽結果
items.body: 確認報告反映目前輸入的資料

items.title: 5. 匯出報告
items.body: 只有符合條件時才能匯出完整報告

en.caption: Figure 1 | A minimum complete flow
en.description: Check ingredients after ordering; available and unavailable are conditional branches, not sequential steps.

en.caption: Figure 2 | A minimum complete document workflow
en.description: Enter, check, correct and recheck, preview, then export. Missing input blocks complete export; edits invalidate the old result.

items.title: 2. Check data
items.body: The system checks for missing required fields

items.title: 3. Show feedback and correct
items.body: Block complete export when input is missing; check again after correction

items.title: 4. Preview the result
items.body: Confirm the report reflects the current input

items.title: 5. Export the report
items.body: Allow complete-report export only when conditions are met
